headline: MIL @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.73 at ATL 4.19, with a projected total of 8.92. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: MIL moved +0.26 runs while ATL moved -0.01, changing the projected margin by +0.27 runs. Pitching context: Robert Gasser has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Michael Harris II, Christian Yelich, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jake Bauers, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
